top_concerns: ZSPAPrune's headline numbers use a per-benchmark balance coefficient k chosen on the same evaluation splits (§4.2, Table 1 = best cell of Table 2); the advantage over DivPrune disappears at many other k values (DA-C1, upheld)
Only one real baseline (DivPrune) plus a self-built relevance-only baseline; 'matches or surpasses the state-of-the-art' unsupported; no text-guided or VisionZip-type baselines
The prompt's contribution is never isolated (no random-core, shuffled-prompt or k=0 control); GQA and POPE peak at the most diversity-heavy k tested, so 'must be prompt-aware' is not shown
No variance or significance analysis (the stated reason, deterministic inference, is not valid); gains are 0.1-1.3 points absolute on Qwen and identical to DivPrune in 5 of 12 LLaVA cells
Efficiency claims overstated: one model, 1.2-1.6% memory saving, slower than DivPrune; single keep rate (90%); missing setup details and no code at submission
notes: The literature check could not run: related_search.py's single strict-mode query hung until the arXiv API timed out ('arXiv API unreachable'); the skill's no-network fallback (off, references marked [verify]) was followed, so no novelty profile, similarity, scout or coverage output exists and all missing references are [verify]. SKILL.md and the Domain agent require a novelty delta table, baseline scout and field snapshot that depend on search results; the fallback wording ('build from knowledge') is workable but leaves little guidance on how much weight unverified references may carry. The integrity scan ran clean. In the DA criterion-3 decision table, the field-practice exception ('order of application') is ambiguous when a paper itself calls a split 'official test split' but another table implies a validation-sized subset (MMMU: 900 samples vs 11.5K), and for GQA test-dev; I applied the table to POPE (no validation split) and treated MMMU/GQA as softened but not exempt. The EIC step 'start every reviewer at 1.0' conflicts mildly with the need to move weights for R3's lenient praise; resolved by moving only for a verified point. The cross-check (composite band 2 vs rating 3) was within one step and not used to depart. The Phase 1.6 report-check table is written after the reports are final, so it documents changes only as a record, which is slightly artificial for a single-context run.
